case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Informed purpose and cross-course use, accountable lifecycle ownership, access/correction and contestability of consequential profiling.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Although N150 PC12, N016, N017, and N001 provide general consent, data-update, FOI access/correction, and contestability principles, no relevant provision assigning accountable lifecycle ownership for cross-course AI learner profiling, ensuring unit instructors know of its cross-course scope, or governing contestability of consequential profiling was identified in the documents and searches checked ('learner profile', 'student profiling', 'course data', 'data sharing', 'consent purpose', 'access correction', 'privacy complaint').
case_summary.case_note: Curtin's N150 PC12, N016/N017, and N001 provide prior consent, secondary-use PIA controls, FOI access and correction, and AI transparency and contestability principles. No relevant provision assigning accountable lifecycle ownership for persistent cross-course AI learner profiling, informing instructors of cross-course profile scope, or operationalising contestability of consequential profiling was identified in the documents and searches checked (D5=2, Critical gap=Yes). Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.

Principle 6: Transparency, Explainability and Contestability
Develop, deploy and use AI systems in a way that maximises transparency,
explainability and contestability. Allow stakeholders to know when AI has
been used and contest decisions made using AI.
Principle 7: Accountability
Implement human oversight, review and the ability to intervene for all AI-
based functions and decisions. Identify the individual accountable for any
decision made using AI. Maintain records on the use of AI to comply with
recordkeeping obligations.
